source: Reserve Bank of India, Monetary Policy Statement 2026-27, Resolution of the Monetary Policy Committee, 5-7 October 2026: policy repo rate increased by 25 bps to 5.50 per cent.
note: The repo rate is the risk-free anchor for the cost of money tied up in a case. It is not the interest a court may award. Borrowing costs and the claimant's own cost of capital are usually higher; the input can be overridden.
